sources.title: H Company releases Holo4 open-weight models for computer-use agents
sources.snippet: H Company released Holo4 on September 28, 2026, offering 27B dense and 35B-A3B MoE models with open weights on Hugging Face and API access. The models are designed for cross-platform computer use, supporting desktops, web, Android, and code sandboxes through a unified interface.
